vision_helper.model_structure: Text model is loaded vocab-only. mtmd_init_from_file loads the separate mmproj vision encoder/projector; n_embd is read from clip.vision.projection_dim.
vision_helper.preprocessing: mtmd_helper_bitmap_init_from_file loads the image; mtmd_tokenize forms image chunks with the default marker and mtmd_encode_chunk produces embeddings. Exact resize/crop/tiling policy is delegated to mtmd and is not specified in this helper source. Setup caps image tokens at 1024 for GPU and 300 for CPU.

protocol.file_header: five int32 values {0x31455653 (SVE1), n_tokens, nx, ny, n_embd}
protocol.payload: float32[n_tokens][n_embd]; row i maps to x=i%nx,y=i//nx
protocol.endianness: native int32; little-endian on this Windows host; no explicit endian/version field beyond magic
protocol.server_cache: SHA-256 of normalized image bytes, first 32 hex characters

vision_helper.server_input_normalization: JPEG, PNG, BMP and GIF pass through; other formats use Pillow and become PNG; transparent RGBA/LA are composited on white.
vision_helper.gpu_startup: GPU mode warms with a synthetic 2048x2048 gray image before READY; CPU mode skips warmup.
